title: Review shared CLI, command, dispatch, capability, and tooling support modules
scope: Primary ownership for src/shared CLI, command-registry, dispatch, capability, completions, legacy entrypoint, and tooling-bin helpers assigned to #413 in the shared-module ledger.

summary.overallAssessment: This shared surface is mostly healthy and acts as the repo's canonical command and CLI contract layer. The P2 cleanup items from this review are complete: display state/event/layout/palette/frame responsibilities are split behind the public display facade, dispatch projection helpers are owned by command-registry query code, dispatch runtime-env resolution moved to the CLI entrypoint owner, and runtime-capability flag/surface projection moved behind the public manifest API.

runtimeRisks.reason: The public display orchestrator delegates task-state mutation, JSONL event writing, safe-stream handling, terminal resolution, and rendering to display-internal owners.
Display row assembly now delegates task ordering/layout to layout.js, palette/theme state to palette.js, and terminal row-diff rendering to frame.js.
The public manifest API now delegates static specs, helper builders, and flag/surface projection to focused runtime-capability owners.

maintainabilityOnlyNotes.reason: This old thin projection is no longer present. Keep future dispatch projection cleanup centered on the live src/shared/dispatch/registry.js and command-registry query owners.
Now a thin facade over dispatch registry helpers owned by src/shared/command-registry-query.js.
The current package-script replacement surface is almost empty and should either stay intentionally tiny or be folded into command-surface reporting if it remains documentation-only.
The root helper was moved to tools/cli/completions-renderer.js because shell-completion rendering is only used by the completions CLI tool.
The root helper was moved to src/shared/runtime-capability/builders.js because it is only consumed by runtime-capability-manifest.js.
